transcript.content: Hello. I'm glad you're here today. What brings you in to see me?

Lately I keep thinking everyone would be better off if I just disappeared, and those thoughts are starting to scare me. I've just been in such a dark place, and my friend was so worried about me that they drove me here today.
Have you ever had periods in your life where you felt the exact opposite of this—such as having unusually high energy, racing thoughts, or needing very little sleep?

Yes, a few months ago I had a stretch where I felt completely wired and only slept about three hours a night while buzzing with energy. I felt like a visionary genius, working through the night and reorganizing my apartment, but my brain would jump all over the place. During those times, I'd swing from feeling giddy to snapping at my coworkers over the smallest things.
How long did that period of high energy and decreased sleep typically last—was it just a few days, or did it go on for a week or more?
Those high-energy periods usually lasted for a few weeks at a time. It definitely wasn't just a couple of days; I would keep up that intense pace for weeks before I finally crashed.
During those weeks when you felt that high energy, did it cause major problems in your life, such as serious trouble at work, risky behaviors, or even needing to be hospitalized?

Yes, it caused major issues, though I was never hospitalized. At work, my irritability and snapping at coworkers got so bad that my manager quietly took me off client-facing presentations because I was overcommitting the team and leaving projects unfinished. At home, I was staying up all night compulsively reorganizing my apartment and swiping on dating apps, which just wasn't like me.
How long have you been feeling this low, and have you also lost interest in your usual activities during this time?

This current dark stretch has been going on for about a month now without really letting up. I've completely lost interest in my usual activities, like the sustainable transportation project I used to love, and I've stopped showing up to my weekend hiking club.
During either your high-energy times or this current dark period, have you ever heard voices, seen things that others couldn't, or had beliefs that felt very real but others found strange?
No, I haven't experienced anything like that. I've never heard voices, seen things that aren't there, or had any strange beliefs like that.
During this past month of feeling so low, have you still been able to manage your daily responsibilities like work and basic self-care, or has it become nearly impossible to function?

It has become nearly impossible to function, and my life has completely ground to a halt. At work, I've missed critical deadlines and can't focus on basic calculations, which is why my manager had to take me off client presentations. At home, dishes are piling up, mail is unopened, and I'm just too exhausted to do anything but stare at the ceiling.
